adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition in the pagination actions. Looking at the diff, the `next` and `previous` actions in admin-group.js.es6 (lines 30-47) call `group.findMembers()` which is an async AJAX call. There's no guard to prevent multiple in-flight requests - if a user clicks rapidly, multiple requests can be sent, and responses may return out of order. The `findMembers` method in group.js (lines 24-38) uses `self.setProperties` to update offset and members from the response, so a slower older response could overwrite newer data. The `showingFirst`/`showingLast` guards only prevent clicks at boundaries, not rapid clicks during pagination. This is a real race condition bug.
